name: Warm tint
description: Tints the picture towards a colour, warm by default. At full amount every colour is multiplied by the tint, so white becomes the tint itself.

params.label: Amount
params.description: How far the picture moves towards the tint: 0 leaves it exactly as it is, 1 multiplies it by the tint.

params.label: Tint
params.description: The colour the picture is multiplied by, as it is picked (sRGB values from 0 to 1). Its alpha is not used.

author: Example Author
